title: DoorCloser
description: Spigot plugin to automatically close and sync doors, trapdoors and gates  that were opened by a player, with permissions and configuration
body:
# Minecraft-DoorCloser

## Feature List
- Close (Revert) **doors**, **trapdoors** and **fence gates** automatically after player interaction
- Sync **double-doors** (Opening one also opens the other)
- Configurable: Allow ignoring functionality when **sneaking**, in **creative mode** or by granting **permission** `doorcloser.bypass`
- Configurable: List of doors, trapdoors and fence gates affected by the plugin

## About DoorCloser

Minecraft (Spigot server) plugin to automatically close doors / gates / trap-doors that were opened by a player, with permissions and configuration

Default configuration can be found here: https://github.com/Maingron/Minecraft-DoorCloser/blob/v2.0.1/src/main/resources/config.yml

You can configure which doors are in scope to be auto-closed, as well as if they should close when the player is in creative mode or is sneaking. I recommend leaving both of those as false to support using things like trap doors as decoration blocks (sides of chairs, etc.)

Spigot resource page of original plugin by Psychlist1972: https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/auto-door-closer-for-spigot.44093/ (1.12, 1.13)
